title: Re: NOYA x CRUSH Agency — Egypt production support
subject: Re: NOYA x CRUSH Agency — Egypt production support
body:
Hi Sophie,

Following my note last week, I have put the three settings into a few pages, with how CRUSH and NOYA would split the work.

If one of them fits a brand in your calendar, twenty minutes is enough to choose a setting, and we will come back with venues, logistics and a costed outline.

Best,
Adam Elshazly
Founder, NOYA Concierge
noyaconcierge.com

sources.fact: Sophie replied on 5 Oct: would love to connect, and asked for a portfolio of NOYA's productions.
sources.source: CRM Gmail history, thread 'NOYA x CRUSH Agency — Egypt production support'

sources.fact: Adam replied on 8 Oct with the Brands & Production brochure; no answer since.
Paris and Dubai event agency founded in 2009 by Sophie Christophe, working across arts, music and fashion.
sources.source: Entrepreneur Middle East; Campaign Middle East

sources.fact: CRUSH collaborations include Cartier with Gloria Gaynor, IWC with Jamiroquai and Kehlani with Huda Beauty.
ICONS. by CRUSH is its talent and audience division; CRUSH has opened in Doha.
The Grand Egyptian Museum has opened near the Pyramids of Giza, giving Cairo a cultural landmark of global scale.
Dior presented its Men's Fall 2023 show at the Pyramids of Giza, a first for a luxury house at the site.
sources.source: NOYA Brands Proposal (market reference, not NOYA work); widely reported

sources.fact: Luxury hospitality continues to grow across Cairo, El Gouna and the North Coast.

review: Follow-up for 26 Oct in the 19 Oct thread, only if Sophie has not replied. Carries the editorial brief v3 (READY FOR ATTACHMENT).
